title: Final Project — Choose Your Own Adventure

content.title: Your Biggest Program Yet
content.summary: You'll build a full branching adventure using everything from Module 3.
content.body:
This is it — your Module 3 final project. You're going to build a real choose-your-own-adventure game using everything you've learned:

• `input()` to ask the player questions
• variables to remember their name and choices
• `print()` to tell the story
• `if` / `else` to branch the adventure

There's no single right answer here. The story is yours.

content.title: The Requirements
content.summary: Ask at least 3 questions, use the player's name, write `if`/`else` for each choice, create multiple different endings.
content.body:
Your adventure needs:

✅ Ask the player their name — and use it in the story
✅ Ask at least 3 different choices (doors, paths, items, actions...)
✅ Use `if` / `else` for each choice
✅ At least two different endings that feel meaningfully different
✅ Make it fun — give it personality, humor, weirdness

content.title: Story Ideas
content.summary: Space station, haunted bakery, dragon academy, underwater city — pick a world you'd want to explore.
content.body:
Stuck for a setting? Try one of these:

🚀 Lost on a space station — airlocks, robots, zero gravity
🏰 Exploring a haunted castle — friendly ghosts, secret passages
🐉 Dragon Academy — choose your dragon, your spell, your destiny
🌊 Underwater city — merpeople, sunken treasure, a very polite shark
🍩 The Haunted Bakery — mysterious pastries, a ghost chef, a missing recipe

Or make up your own world entirely.

content.title: A Starting Shape
content.summary: Here's the skeleton — fill in the story details, choices, and endings.
content.body: Here's a skeleton to build on:
content.codeBlock:
name = input("What is your name, adventurer? ")
print("Welcome, " + name + "! Your adventure begins...")

choice1 = input("Do you go left or right? ")

if choice1 == "left":
    print("You head left...")
    # keep going!
else:
    print("You head right...")
    # keep going!
content.note: Add more choices inside each branch to make the story longer.

editorPrompt: Build a choose-your-own-adventure game with 3+ choices and multiple endings. Use `input()`, `if`/`else`, and `print()`.

challenge: 🚀 Dive Deeper: Add a score system! Create a variable called `score = 0` at the start. Each time the player makes a "good" choice, add to it: `score = score + 1`. At the very end, `print()` their final score. How high can a player get?
